verdicts.reason: A is jumbled: the RSVP CTA has been shrunk to the size of the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills, so it no longer stands out. The italic tagline is wrapped into a narrow five-line column, the URL and fine print are tiny, the partner mark is cropped to an unreadable sliver, and the reading order zigzags. B has clear columns (title, date, then pills and a large RSVP button) and keeps the hierarchy, but the can floats loosely beside the logo, the 'missing asset' placeholder box is prominent at the right, and the right side is left with uneven empty space.
